findings.summary: Exported sparse-page parser has no production caller.
findings.consequence: The server utility surface keeps a parallel page-index validation path that current production code does not use, so future changes to Editor bounds semantics can drift between this helper and the manifest validation code without affecting any shipped route until someone accidentally adopts the stale helper.
findings.evidence: The owned export starts at line 176. Repository search for parseEditorPageIndexes found only this definition and test/unit/editor-reader-html.spec.ts references. The current Editor route consumes bounds from fetchEditorManifest, and server/utils/work-manifest-validation.ts validates sparse bounds and complete page mappings separately through validSparseBounds, validPages, and pagesMatchBounds.
findings.recommendation: Delete parseEditorPageIndexes and its dedicated test unless a production caller is added. For current behavior, keep sparse page bounds validation centralized in server/utils/work-manifest-validation.ts and consume the generated EditorPageBounds type from shared/types/work-manifest.ts.
